releaseNotes:
• Official Signed Release v1.1.0 (Build 11)
• Real-Time Private Chat: WhatsApp-style real-time messaging between Google accounts
• Real-Time Presence: Online/offline indicator and last seen timestamps
• Real-Time Typing Indicator: Live 'typing...' status in chat header
• Real Voice Calls: Full two-way audio calling powered by WebRTC with STUN NAT traversal
• Real Video Calls: Two-way live video and audio streaming with PiP local camera preview, front/back camera switch, and mute/video controls
• In-App Call History: Full logging of incoming, outgoing, and missed calls in the Calls tab
• High-reliability In-App Updater with SHA-256 cryptographic verification and seamless package installer delivery
